$comment: Visual Comfort & Co. (decorative lighting, Visual Comfort Group) runs a custom storefront with product pages under /us/p/<product-slug>-<model> (for example Charleston Medium Lantern, 5291004). The product name is the h1, the description is the meta description and the price is in the page's JSON-LD and the rendered price block ($721.65 on the sample). The specifications are rendered by the page's scripts, so they are not in the server HTML: fetch.engine is default (APP_DEFAULT_ENGINE, ai-crawler-avalai on this instance) with ai_fetch browser (Chrome renders the page first), and the LLM returns the price (72165 cents, available), the image and 29 specs, each checked against the page, at about 9,109+1,575 tokens per request. The direct AI page fetch returns malformed output (AI_BAD_OUTPUT), so the browser fetch is used. Engines tried on the sample on 2026-11-19: http: SUCCESS with title and description, no price; browser: the same; ai-crawler-avalai (AI page fetch over http): AI_BAD_OUTPUT; ai-crawler-avalai with ai_fetch browser: SUCCESS with price, image and 29 specs; web_search: success but unverified (2 specs). Needs APP_AI_CRAWLER_ENABLED and APP_BROWSER_ENABLED on the instance, with an AvalAI key. Checked against the saved (curl) Charleston Medium Lantern page on 2026-11-19.
